description: This file defines a 'Table' interface class for accessibility purposes, providing methods to interact with tabular data structures, including selection, retrieval of cells, headers, and extents, and properties for table metadata.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: An accessibility interface class representing tabular data, providing methods for selection, cell access, headers, extents, and properties related to tables.

methods.name: addColumnSelection
methods.description: Selects a specific column, adding it to current selection if permitted.

methods.name: addRowSelection
methods.description: Selects a specific row, adding it to current selection if permitted.

methods.name: getAccessibleAt
methods.description: Retrieves the accessible object at a specified row and column.

methods.name: getColumnAtIndex
methods.description: Returns the first column spanned by a child at a given 1-D index.

methods.name: getColumnDescription
methods.description: Provides a text description of a specific table column.

methods.name: getColumnExtentAt
methods.description: Returns how many columns a cell at a specific row and column spans.

methods.name: getColumnHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the header accessible object for a specific column.

methods.name: getIndexAt
methods.description: Returns the 1-D index of a cell given its row and column.

methods.name: getRowAtIndex
methods.description: Returns the row index for a child at a given 1-D index.

methods.name: getRowColumnExtentsAtIndex
methods.description: Provides row and column extents and selection status for a child at a given index.

methods.name: getRowDescription
methods.description: Provides a text description of a specific row.

methods.name: getRowExtentAt
methods.description: Returns how many rows a cell at a specific row and column spans.

methods.name: getRowHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the accessible object for a row header.

methods.name: getSelectedColumns
methods.description: Returns indices of all currently selected columns.

methods.name: getSelectedRows
methods.description: Returns indices of all currently selected rows.

methods.name: isColumnSelected
methods.description: Checks if a specific column is selected.

methods.name: isRowSelected
methods.description: Checks if a specific row is selected.

methods.name: isSelected
methods.description: Checks if a specific cell at row and column is selected.

methods.name: removeColumnSelection
methods.description: Deselects a specific column.

methods.name: removeRowSelection
methods.description: Deselects a specific row.

methods.name: get_caption
methods.description: Returns the caption accessible object for the table.

methods.name: get_nColumns
methods.description: Returns total number of columns in the table.

methods.name: get_nRows
methods.description: Returns total number of rows in the table.

methods.name: get_nSelectedColumns
methods.description: Returns number of currently selected columns.

methods.name: get_nSelectedRows
methods.description: Returns number of currently selected rows.

methods.name: get_summary
methods.description: Returns a summary accessible object for the table.
